rationale: The control-width check of the legacy struct path is removed: a 5-wide u for the F-16 config (or a 3- or 5-wide u for an AC without controlNames) is silently accepted (the extra entry ignored, or a missing one read out of range by the loads function).
The staleRuntime guard is not called by the flat plant: an edited S, mass, aeroScale ... of a toRuntime struct is silently ignored (the plant evaluates the model the struct came from).

pattern: if ok && c.hasAeroScale, ok = isequal(AC.aeroScale, c.aeroScale); end
rationale: The guard fingerprint leaves out aeroScale: editing AC.aeroScale.Cm_q on a toRuntime struct (the M8 uncertainty knob) is silently ignored, the I0/CORE_AUDIT example of a stale bridge.
The context drops the state X (the I0 bridge defect F-3): a component that reads fl.X sees []. Caught by the check of the context against the state itself, not only against the constructor.

pattern: C = kin.C_bn; h = kin.H; atm = kin.Atm;
rationale: The context a plant with its own kinematics (derivativesRotating) builds has no C_bn: the bridge context differs from the direct one (C_bn empty, as before I1).

pattern: if nargout > 1, [xdot, y] = AC.derivatives(x, u, env); else, xdot = AC.derivatives(x, u, env); end
rationale: Model dispatch bypassed: the plant evaluates the OBJECT path (Loads objects, aggregate) instead of the compiled path; equal to round-off only, so the E = 0 contract with the struct path and model.derivatives breaks.
An uncompiled model is not compiled by the plant, so model.derivatives falls back to the object path (round-off different, and slow).
Finding F-7 back: an unclassified component (the analytic aircraft) is left out of the kind sums, so y.F_aero reads 0 while the body force is ~1 kN, a silent wrong number instead of NaN.
Finding F-8 back: the compiled y has no F_aero, M_aero, F_prop, M_prop, so the model path and the struct path give different y fields.

pattern: info.M_aero_transfer = info.M_aero_transfer + cross(c.r(:, k) - c.r_mrc, F_R(:, k));
rationale: Finding F-6 back: with two aero components at different points the rotating plant takes the aero moment about the CG from the FIRST point only.
The rotating plant silently mis-sizes u: a 5- or 3-wide u for the F-16 config reaches its loadsFcn.
The aero table no longer declares its kind: every aero diagnostic of a real aircraft becomes NaN (unclassified), and the F-16 model y no longer equals the struct path.
